handling: Excluded from all metrics together with their orders; logged in excluded_records.csv (not deleted from raw).

impact_if_ignored: Affiliate would have 540 'customers' instead of 505; delivered revenue overstated by Rs 779,790 (13.6% of all delivered revenue).

issue_description: 206 order_ids appear twice (412 rows involved). Detail: 206 are exact duplicate rows; 0 order_ids have conflicting content (different user/date/value/status).
handling: Kept the first occurrence of each order_id, removed the exact repeats; logged in excluded_records.csv. All duplicates were exact copies, so no conflict resolution was needed.
business_justification: An order_id identifies one real order; a byte-identical repeat is a duplicate export, not a second purchase. Genuine repeat purchases have distinct order_ids and were kept.
impact_if_ignored: Delivered revenue overstated by Rs 203,594; 62 users would look like repeat buyers only because of a duplicated row.
